description.en: An idempotence token used to make the request idempotent. A universally unique identifier (UUID) is recommended.

descriptions.zh:
## 请求说明
- 该接口用于将指定ID的审批流程定义设置为停用状态。
- 停用后，该审批流程定义将不再生效，直到被重新启用。
- 需要提供有效的流程定义ID作为路径参数。
descriptions.en:
## Request

- This API disables the specified approval process definition.

- A disabled approval process definition remains inactive until it is re-enabled.

- You must provide a valid process definition ID as a path parameter.
